evidence: The trip starts at State Highway 73 on the true right of the Waimakariri, just south of the Waimakariri road bridge (about 10 km east of Arthur’s Pass village).
Finish by climbing up and over Kelly Range or by continuing down the Taipo River to the road.
The track ends on SH73 about 10 km west of Jacksons Tavern.

ways.label: Alternative finish over Kelly Range via Kellys Creek

start.name: State Highway 73 south of the Waimakariri road bridge
start.quote: The trip starts at State Highway 73 on the true right of the Waimakariri, just south of the Waimakariri road bridge

end.name: main road at Kellys Creek
end.quote: emerges at Kellys Creek, 5 minutes from the main road

evidence: From Carroll Hut the track runs directly across the tussock in front of the hut to the lip of the basin.
Once in the bush it drops more steeply and emerges at Kellys Creek, 5 minutes from the main road.

doubts: Start ref F1 is the only road end in the packet (an unnamed track meeting West Coast Road, i.e. SH73); the first leg is only referred to the Carrington Hut route guide, so the walked line to Carrington Hut is not described here. The main end on SH73 west of Jacksons Tavern and the Kellys Creek end have no matching road-end feature. The alternative over Kelly Range is given its own heading with 'Time: 6 hr' for the Seven Mile Creek to SH73 section only, so no whole-way time is recorded for W2. Carroll Hut is on the Kelly Range alternative only. Whether the Julia Hut ref T11 marks the newer or older hut is unknown. Dillons homestead is an alternative place to stay a little further on from Dillon Hut; whether the route passes it is not stated. Ariels Tarns and Whitehorn Pass are routes from Harman Pass not to be followed.
